A Components page shipped in the navigation is a page that has to be kept working, gets linked to, and eventually gets a state nobody rendered anywhere else — a gallery that is more complete than the product. Here it is rendered by `tests/test_components.py` and photographed by `tests/e2e/test_component_states.py`, and neither needs it to be reachable. It lives under `tests/` rather than in the template tree for the same reason: a file in `web/templates/` is a file `test_every_template_is_present` and the class-coverage guard both count, and a fixture is not part of the served product.
